uncited: A sparse octree representation for real-time rendering.
The pipeline that utilizes NCB to transform a trained NeRF-SH model into a sparse octree.
-   **Test Time:** Rendering time is comparable to or slightly better than Plenoxels.
-   **Deployment Time:** NCB reduces disk I/O and host-device transfer times significantly due to smaller size.
It addresses the limitations of existing compact radiance field methods by providing a mechanism to recover high-frequency details lost during grid compression.
